map.输入钼丝径、切割速度与工件厚度，估算实际进给速度、表面粗糙度 Ra 及对应加工精: Enter molybdenum-wire diameter, cutting speed and workpiece thickness to estimate actual feed speed, surface roughness Ra and the corresponding machining precision grade.
map.进给速度 = 切割速度/工件厚度；Ra ≈ 0.8+1.2·(d/0.18)·(: Feed speed = cutting speed / workpiece thickness; Ra about 0.8 + 1.2 times (d/0.18) times (cutting speed/100)^0.6
map.基于线切割(WEDM)工艺模型：进给速度由切割面积效率与厚度决定；表面粗糙度 R: Based on a wire-cut EDM (WEDM) process model: feed speed is determined by cutting-area efficiency and thickness; surface roughness Ra is estimated from molybdenum-wire diameter d and cutting speed by an empirical power law, then mapped to an IT precision grade, for process parameter and precision pre-judgment.
Tip: formula: feed speed = cutting speed / workpiece thickness; Ra about 0.8 + 1.2 times (d/0.18) times (cutting speed/100)^0.6 (empirical model); map Ra to IT precision grade.

map.📚 深度解析：线切割精度计算（进给速度、粗糙度与精度等级）: In-depth: Wire EDM Precision (feed speed, roughness and precision grade)
map.工艺参数制定：由钼丝径与切割速度估算进给速度与表面质量: Process parameter setting: from wire diameter and cutting speed estimate feed speed and surface quality
map.精度预估：按 Ra 判断可达的 IT 等级，匹配图纸要求: Precision estimate: by Ra judge the reachable IT grade, match drawing requirements
map.切缝补偿：算切缝宽度，用于电极丝轨迹偏置设置: Kerf compensation: compute kerf width for electrode-wire path offset setting
map.算法：进给速度 = 切割速度/工件厚度（mm/min）；表面粗糙度 Ra = 0: Algorithm: feed speed = cutting speed / workpiece thickness (mm/min); surface roughness Ra = 0.8 + 1.2 times (wire diameter / 0.18) times (cutting speed / 100)^0.6 (um); precision grade by Ra: at or below 0.4 to IT5 precision cutting, at or below 0.8 to IT6 precision, at or below 1.6 to IT7 fairly precise, at or below 3.2 to IT8 general precise, at or below 6.3 to IT9 ordinary, otherwise IT10 rough; kerf width = wire diameter + 0.02 (mm, 0.02 is the two-side discharge gap); cutting efficiency is the input cutting speed (mm2/min).
map.例：丝径 0.18mm、切割速度 80mm²/min、厚度 40mm → 进给速: Example: wire 0.18 mm, cutting speed 80 mm2/min, thickness 40 mm gives feed speed 2.00 mm/min, Ra 1.85 um, IT8 general precise, kerf 0.200 mm. If cutting speed raised to 140 mm2/min gives feed 3.50 mm/min, Ra 2.27 um, still IT8 but close to the upper limit. If lowered to 40 mm2/min gives feed 1.00 mm/min, Ra 1.32 um, IT7 fairly precise. Switch to 0.10 mm thin wire, speed 80 mm2/min gives feed unchanged but Ra drops to 1.38 um, kerf narrows to 0.120 mm, suits narrow slots and small radii.
map.Ra 与 IT 等级的对应关系是标准吗？: Is the Ra to IT grade mapping a standard?
map.不是严格的国家标准换算。IT 等级是尺寸公差等级，Ra 是表面粗糙度参数，两者只: It is not a strict national-standard conversion. IT grade is a dimensional-tolerance grade, Ra is a surface-roughness parameter; they are only empirically related (generally IT7 corresponds to Ra about 1.6). This tool's mapping is a common rough industry mapping for quick judgment; actual follows the drawing annotation.
map.本工具按单次切割建模。实际精加工普遍采用「粗切—精修—精微修」多刀工艺，后几次切: This tool models single cutting. Actual finish machining widely uses rough-cut, finish-trim, micro-trim multi-pass; later passes have small removal and low discharge energy, progressively removing the recast layer, so Ra can be far below the single-cut prediction; for IT6 to IT7 arrange 3 to 4 cuts.
map.电火花线切割精度计算器，依据钼丝直径、面积切割效率与工件厚度，换算实际进给速度并: The wire electrical-discharge machining precision calculator, from molybdenum-wire diameter, area cutting efficiency and workpiece thickness, converts the actual feed speed and estimates surface roughness Ra, then judges the machining precision grade.
